scope: latest unified 1680-row protocol; early confirmation kept separate
metric_units: means and SD in percent; differences and CI in percentage points (pp)

metric_definition.roc_auc: macro one-versus-rest from softmax float64 sealed scores
metric_definition.auprc: macro class-wise average precision; not trapezoidal PR integral
metric_definition.numerics: canonical server float64 softmax probabilities saved; transport checks normalization within 8 float64 eps, then recomputes exact ranking metrics from canonical probabilities

protocol.ci_scope: same graph, fixed query set, paired support resampling; no multiple-testing correction

audit.note: means, SDs, deltas and bootstrap intervals recomputed from stored raw result/metric rows; no fresh logits inference
